coaching.headline: A clean 3-stack map win — towers 9–5, objectives 20–15. We took the structures and closed at 31 minutes.
coaching.team: This is the trio working: out-towered them 9-5 and converted the objective lead. Willy's Steel set the table (13 assists) and Xeebs' Serath carried the jungle with 43215 objective damage. Cuban's Feng Mao ran quiet at 9144 hero damage, but the map control covered it. Repeat this — control neutrals, convert to towers.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: This is our template as a trio — with one tighten: the 6, 12.9 and 15.2 fights were lost while the winning carry stayed in lane, and 4 of 7 won fights cashed. Shove-and-rotate those and it's a stomp.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

khaimera.loadout: Exarch (Illumination + Fervour), augment Lane Lurker, crest Judgement
lines: Cull at top rank: 60s base, about 44.4s by the end (26% shorter) from 35 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Draconum 15.
12 takedowns (8 kills, 4 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Khaimera dealt 28,881 hero damage, 25% of their team's, with +127 physical power from items.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
Exarch (Eternal): Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.

Sustain: 11% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; Fervour: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes heal you and allies within 1000 units for 2 (+0.5 per level)(+5% Magical Power).; 13,081 healing recorded.
Toughness: +975 health, +40 physical armor; took 62,695 damage, mitigated 42,024, died 9 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Draconum, Judgement, Exarch, Fervour.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Rapture, Exarch, Fervour.
The Eternal was part of it: Exarch (Illumination + Fervour) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Khaimera killed built physical armor (Serath, Steel). Anti-heal on Feng Mao, Serath, Steel. We killed Khaimera 9 times.
Copy it? Too few Khaimera offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

howitzer.loadout: Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna), augment Sniper Shells, crest Epoch

sources.note: random: 29 procs, 1 in 4 is +4 haste (expected value)
sources.how: 29 random bonuses (every 2 min and every takedown), 1 in 4 is +4 haste: about +29 expected

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
ultPlus: Astral Catalyst (Ravenous): Hero Kills reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 25%.• Hero Assists reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 15%.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 61% of the team's kills (more than 90% of Howitzer mid players this patch) and died 5 times (fewer than about 44% of them). Lotus turned 14 takedowns into ability haste, so Make It Rain came back every ~63s instead of 105s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Howitzer touched shortened Make It Rain, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 62.9s late); fight right after Make It Rain is spent.
Make It Rain at top rank: 105s base, about 62.9s by the end (40% shorter) from 67 ability haste: Tainted Scepter 10, Astral Catalyst 20, Epoch 8, Lotus 29.
14 takedowns (7 kills, 7 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice), Astral Catalyst, Lotus (Eternal).
Astral Catalyst (Ravenous): Hero Kills reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 25%.• Hero Assists reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 15%.
Howitzer dealt 35,187 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +360 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11; against Renna (level 17 estimated: about 47 magical armor, 36 after penetration) and Serath (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 49 after penetration) that is about 8% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Astral Catalyst (item): On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Dreambinder (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 30% for 1s. Reduced to 20% for DoT Abilities.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Masterpiece (Eternal minor): Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.

Sustain: Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; Astral Catalyst: On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.; 2,507 healing recorded.
Toughness: +525 health; took 27,551 damage, mitigated 14,406, died 5 times.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Wraith Leggings, Dreambinder. Howitzer has 4 damaging abilities (H11 Cluster Grenades, R2000 Missile, Land Mine hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 67 ability haste brought them back 40% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Sniper Shells.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna) sits on the same trigger as the items (every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Howitzer killed built magical armor (Steel). Anti-heal on Feng Mao, Serath, Steel. We killed Howitzer 5 times.
Copy it? Lotus: 56% in 134 Howitzer midlane games, above the hero's 49.1%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Howitzer's takedowns fed Make It Rain: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Make It Rain is used.

twinblast.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Grenadier, crest Eviscerator
ultPlus: Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,528 hero damage a minute, more than 93% of TwinBlast carry players this patch (36% of the team's). The damage came from Solaris, Imperator, Necrosis.
Ventilate at top rank: 85s base, about 77.3s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Solaris 10.
Necrosis (Necro's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
TwinBlast dealt 47,375 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Bayle (level 17 estimated: about 115 physical armor, 103 after penetration) and Howitzer (level 17 estimated: about 113 physical armor, 101 after penetration) that is about 6% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Solaris (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Necrosis (item): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Solaris: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.; 6,938 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Solaris, Eviscerator, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Solaris, Eviscerator.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players TwinBlast killed built physical armor (Khaimera). Anti-heal on Howitzer. We killed TwinBlast 3 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.4% in 1,445 TwinBlast carry games, below the hero's 50.3%; this 3-item core: 53.6% in 317 games, below the 55.3% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
